decisions.summary: the procedures change, each sheet records its roll in its notes, no sheet is redrawn
decisions.why: for the compound shrine arch (shared or own) and the second kami, the pages the rows cite say the form is rolled from the map's seed (0220 drawing: 'Each map chooses one at random from its seed'; 0218 drawing: 'which form Ochiba's takes is rolled from the map's seed'), and the sorter's own evidence made the no-redraw tier conditional on that roll; no roll was made - the notes record the drawn form as the knob's - so 'no sheet is redrawn' decides the roll's outcome in advance. Legitimate once each such form is rolled with its expression recorded (Hoshigaoka's grove-form precedent) or pinned by a quoted GM ruling, and a roll that lands on the undrawn form moves its row to E3
